## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Verification

List the commands or manual checks actually run.

## Research-contract checklist

- [ ] No dataset, generated screenshot corpus, or checkpoint is included.
- [ ] Tests and documentation match the implemented state; placeholders are identified honestly.
- [ ] Dataset roles, label semantics, split strategy, and evaluation protocol are unchanged, or the relevant ADR has been added/superseded.
- [ ] Scope or priority changes are appended to `docs/scope-and-roadmap.md` and reflected in `docs/project-status.md`.
- [ ] Data-schema compatibility is preserved, or the incompatible change and migration/version impact are documented.
